interest_rate_direction.label: Hold — cuts expected Q3 2026
interest_rate_direction.impact: Neutral near-term. Positive medium-term for growth and rate-sensitive stocks as BoC cuts materialize.

inflation_trend.label: Inflation cooling
inflation_trend.impact: CPI tracking toward 2.1% target. Reduces pressure on BoC to hold rates, supporting rate cut thesis.

economic_growth.label: Below-trend growth
economic_growth.impact: Canadian GDP growth at 1.4% — below potential. Consumer spending constrained by mortgage renewal wave in 2026.

sector_cycle.label: Late cycle — favour quality and defensives
sector_cycle.impact: Late-cycle positioning favours: Financials (earnings resilience), Utilities (defensive yield), Quality Tech (FCF). Headwind for highly cyclical sectors.
